description_html:
Key Features

  • Spacious Infrasound Monitoring Booth: Offers a generous floor area of 70 square metres, providing ample space for equipment and comfortable movement.
  • Ultra-Low Noise Floor: Engineered to maintain a noise floor of just 23 dBA, ensuring highly accurate infrasound measurements without external interference.
  • Group Occupancy: Designed to accommodate up to 5 people, making it suitable for team-based monitoring sessions or collaborative research projects.
  • Extended Session Duration: Supports session lengths of up to 6 hours, ideal for long-term monitoring, data collection, and analysis.
  • Advanced Isolation Technology: Utilizes a resilient floating isolation method to minimize external vibrations and acoustic disturbances, enhancing the integrity of recorded data.
  • Flexible Pricing: Session fee is determined after acceptance, allowing for customized pricing based on specific requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Precise Infrasound Detection: The low ambient noise level enables sensitive detection and accurate measurement of infrasound signals, meeting the needs of scientific research, environmental monitoring, or specialized audio testing.
  • Comfort and Collaboration: Large interior space and group occupancy make it easy for multiple users to work together comfortably, supporting team-based experiments or training.
  • Reliable Long-Term Monitoring: Extended session capability allows for comprehensive studies and uninterrupted data acquisition over several hours.
  • Superior Acoustic Isolation: The resilient floating construction effectively blocks unwanted external noise and vibration, ensuring reliable, uncontaminated results.
  • Adaptable to Project Needs: Customizable session fees and flexible usage terms provide value and adaptability for various research budgets and project scopes.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Scientific Research: Ideal for academic or institutional studies requiring highly controlled acoustic environments for infrasound monitoring.
  • Environmental and Seismic Monitoring: Supports accurate detection of low-frequency environmental or geological events.
  • Audio Equipment Testing: Suitable for manufacturers or engineers needing a quiet, isolated space to test sensitive audio gear.
  • Team-Based Data Collection: Facilitates collaborative research, training, or analysis sessions for groups of up to five participants.
  • Extended Experiments: Perfect for projects that demand continuous, long-duration monitoring without interruption.

Common User Questions Addressed

  • Is the booth quiet enough for sensitive measurements? Yes, the 23 dBA noise floor ensures an exceptionally quiet environment for accurate infrasound detection.
  • How many people can use the booth at once? The booth is designed for up to five occupants, making it suitable for group work.
  • How long can a session last? Each booking allows for up to 6 hours of uninterrupted use.
  • What isolation method is used? The resilient floating isolation technique provides advanced protection against external noise and vibrations.
  • How is pricing determined? Session fees are set after acceptance to accommodate specific project needs and ensure fair pricing.
